{{Quote|You haven't heard of the XR-eight-oh-eight-g?''"<br />"''Should we have?''"<br />"''Not if I've been doing my job.|[[Jae Juun]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]]|<ref name="Dark Nest I: The Joiner King">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref>}}
'''XR808g''', or the '''''Exxer''''', was the smuggling vessel owned and operated by [[Jae Juun]], a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]], and his [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] copilot, [[Tarfang]]. It was a [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] [[YT-1000 light freighter/Legends|YT-1000]]. Its saucer-shaped hull had the cockpit directly on top with four [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] cannons arranged around it. When Juun accompanied [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] to the [[Killik/Legends|Killik]] nest at [[Qoribu]], the ship was destroyed by [[Gorog]] [[dartship]]s while flying via [[slave circuit]], allowing the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] and all present to survive the Gorog attack.

==Name==
{{Quote|XR-eight-oh-eight-g? What kind of a name is that?''"<br />"''It's a Galactic Alliance registration number, of course.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Jae Juun]]|<ref name="Dark Nest I: The Joiner King" />}}
The ship's "name" was simply the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] registration number for the ''Exxer''.
